description: Verify that DUT parses Option Overload value=1 (file holds options) and applies Option 3 (Router) so post-BOUND UDP egress to an unrouted IP uses the gateway as L2 next-hop (RFC 2132 §9.3 + RFC 2131 §3.5/§4.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The `file`-overload variant of CONSTRUCTING_MESSAGES_05. Option Overload value=1 puts the spillover options into BOOTP `file` instead of `sname`; the parser must still walk it. RFC 2132 §9.3 walks options → file → sname (last-wins) when overload is in effect.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND, with OFFER carrying:
   • Option 52 (Option Overload) = 1 (file holds options)
   • Option 3 (Router) embedded in `file`
2. Tester → DUT: triggers DUT to send a UDP to an unrouted IP (must go via gateway).
3. DUT → wire: UDP
   • Ethernet next-hop MAC == gateway MAC (resolved via Option 3 router)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP uses the Option-3 router as L2 next-hop.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request — DORA missing
• Fail_no_dut_udp — DUT did not emit UDP to the unused-routed IP via the router option

verdicts.Pass: DUT applied file-overloaded Option 3 router — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_udp: No DUT UDP to unused-routed IP via the router option
